components.name: Code trace
components.description: Coordinated source, variable watch, output, and explanation. Watch prose follows the selected locale; Java identifiers and code tokens remain unchanged.
components.css: .ds-code{background:var(--editor,#1d2c29);color:var(--code-text,#e2e6c5);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #20372812}.ds-file{font-family:var(--sans, "DM Sans", sans-serif);font-size:12px;padding:12px 17px;background:#253630;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff16;color:#c2cdbd}.ds-code pre{font:12px/2.1 ui-monospace,monospace;padding:15px 18px;overflow-x:auto}.ds-value{font:11px ui-monospace,monospace;color:var(--lime,#d8e898);padding:7px 18px 19px}.ds-console{font-family:var(--sans, "DM Sans", sans-serif);font-size:12px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff16;background:#192723;padding:16px 18px;color:#a8b6a7}.ds-console pre{padding:0;color:#e1ebd2}.ds-control:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.96)}.ds-control:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#406b30);outline-offset:4px}.ds-control:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}

components.name: Topic picker
components.description: In-unit topic selection beside endpoint-disabled previous/next controls; a quiet PDF-page reference follows.
components.css: .ds-picker{font-family:var(--sans,"DM Sans",sans-serif);color:var(--ink,#213b35);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}.ds-picker label{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#64736b)}.ds-picker-controls{display:flex;gap:7px;flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-picker select{width:100%;min-width:0;flex:1;border:1px solid #bdc9b4;background:var(--surface,#fffefa);color:inherit;border-radius:7px;padding:10px 12px;font:12px var(--sans,sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-picker button{display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;width:36px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dddfd4);background:transparent;border-radius:6px;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease}.ds-picker button:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.96)}.ds-picker select:focus-visible,.ds-picker button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#406b30);outline-offset:4px}.ds-picker button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}

narrative.overview:
Warm paper and green ink frame a quiet learning lab. Serif headings establish the reading hierarchy; compact sans-serif controls keep topic selection and practice precise. A dark code surface gives source, values, and output their own material without turning the workspace into a dashboard.

This is a scan of the implemented interface, grounded in `src/app/globals.css`, the learning workspace, and the code panel. The managed-access extension also uses `src/app/auth.css` and the authentication components, retaining the same world. The direction was code-first; there is no approved image comp. Directional vocabulary comes from the recorded learning-lab contract rather than a new identity workshop.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper with green ink and lime emphasis
Serif lesson hierarchy with compact sans-serif controls
Ruled separation and restrained soft corners
Coordinated source, variable, output, and explanation states

rules.name: The Two Materials Rule
rules.body: Use paper for explanation and the dark editor for code, output, and revealed solutions.

rules.name: The Reading Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Reserve Newsreader for headings and lesson numerals; use DM Sans for prose and controls, and monospace for source and values.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate ordinary sections with rules and space; reserve the diffuse shadow for the code panel.

dos: Do preserve the serif heading and sans-serif control relationship.
Do pair selected state color with a border, numeral, weight, or text cue.
Do preserve horizontal scrolling for activity tabs and code, and wrapping labels in the mobile unit grid.
Do disable arrival animation and transitions for reduced motion.
donts: Don't turn every lesson section into an elevated card.
Don't use the lime highlight as ordinary body text on paper.
Don't clip bilingual labels or code to force a fixed layout.
